title: Forms: Build a Contact Form From Widgets | Orchard Core
description:
Visitors need a way to write to you, and a form needs a place on a page, fields, and a button.

The Forms module provides a widget for each part of a form. You put a Form widget on a page, add Input, Select, Text Area, and Button widgets inside it, and publish the page.

In this video:
• How a form is built from a Form widget and field widgets
• Enabling the Forms feature, creating a page, and adding the Form widget
• Text fields: Input widgets for a name and an email address
• A Select, a Text Area, and a Button, then publishing the page
• The form on the site
